sections.title: A course that is a web page

beats.say: This is not a video file. It is a web page that plays itself against an audio track. Every slide you see is live markup, which is what makes the rest of this possible.
You can ask a question at any point. If the course already answers it, you get the section and the timestamp, and you can jump straight there.
When the course does not cover your question, it writes a new slide, narrates it, and drops it in at the end of the section you were watching. That is the part a finished video cannot do.
